channel.title: The Quant Scientist
channel.description: We test what traders believe. Al Brooks price action and popular trading strategies — coded in Python, backtested on real data, results shared honestly.

item.title: I Coded Al Brooks' Buy Signal Bar in Python and Tested It on 23,000 Bars
item.description: What happens when you translate Al Brooks' most-used bullish entry trigger into a strict mathematical formula and backtest it on real SPY data? The results are more nuanced than you'd expect.

item.title: I Backtested the 3 Most Popular RSI Strategies. Here's the Autopsy.
item.description: RSI 70/30, RSI divergence, and RSI + 200MA — three strategies taught on thousands of blogs and YouTube channels. I ran all three on 15 years of SPY data. Two lost money. One barely broke even.

item.title: Al Brooks' Trend Bars vs Trading Range Bars — Coded in Python
item.description: Before you can use any Brooks setup, you need to read individual bars correctly. Trend bars and trading range bars are the foundation — here's how to define them in code and what the data shows.
